payload.text:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/orbital-shell-android",
    "crates/orbital-shell-ios",
    "crates/orbital-shell-chrome",
    "crates/orbital-core",
    "crates/orbital-core/crates/base",
    "crates/orbital-core/crates/eval",
    "crates/orbital-core/crates/runtime",
    "crates/io-gate",
    "crates/orbital-router",
    "crates/orbital-compiler",
    "crates/orbital-lolo",
    "crates/orbital-shell-typescript",
    "crates/orbital-shell-python",
    "crates/orbital-shell-rust",
    "crates/orbital-server",
    "crates/orbital-shell-rust/renderers/dioxus",
    "crates/orbital-shell-rust/renderers/tui",
    "crates/orbital-canvas",
    "crates/orbital-ffi",
    "crates/orbital-wasm",
    "crates/orbital-node",
    "crates/orbital-python",
    "crates/orbital-cli",
    "crates/orbital-verify",
    "crates/orbital-test-support",
    "crates/orbital-integration-tests",
]

[workspace.package]
version = "18.0.5"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-rust"

[workspace.dependencies]
# Serialization
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1.0", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
serde_path_to_error = "0.1"

# Async runtime
tokio = { version = "1.0", features = ["full"] }

# Server
axum = "0.7"
tower = "0.4"
tower-http = { version = "0.5", features = ["cors", "trace", "compression-br", "compression-gzip"] }

# Database
sqlx = { version = "0.7", features = ["runtime-tokio", "postgres", "sqlite"] }

# Client/Game (bevy disabled for faster compile times)
# bevy = "0.13"
# bevy_egui = "0.25"

# HTTP client (using rustls to avoid OpenSSL dependency)
reqwest = { version = "0.11", default-features = false, features = ["json", "rustls-tls"] }
# ureq: sync HTTP for the client bridge (localhost over HTTP). `default-features = false`
# drops ureq's default TLS (rustls → ring), which has no wasm32 C backend; the
# client only speaks HTTP, so TLS is unused here.
ureq = { version = "2.9", default-features = false, features = ["json"] }

# TUI
ratatui = "0.29"
crossterm = "0.28"

# Utilities
thiserror = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
lru = "0.12"
lazy_static = "1.4"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
parking_lot = "0.12"
semver = "1"

# CLI
clap = { version = "4.0", features = ["derive"] }

# Testing
pretty_assertions = "1.4"

# Dioxus (separate client renderer crate — `orbital-client-dioxus`)
dioxus = { version = "0.7", default-features = false }

# Vendored patch: dioxus-native 0.7.9's `Config::default()` references the
# optional `dioxus_cli_config` dep without a feature guard, so the crate cannot
# compile with default features off — which wasm32 requires (tokio/devtools
# have no wasm build, and `hot-reload`'s `dioxus_devtools::connect` is non-wasm).
# The vendored copy guards the call behind `#[cfg(feature = "hot-reload")]`.
# Remove once a fixed dioxus-native release lands.
# wasm32 release builds: size over everything else. The default `release`
# profile emits ~48MB binaries (no LTO, debuginfo kept); this profile + the
# build scripts' wasm-opt pass brings the glue down to something a browser can
# compile in seconds. Desktop/server builds keep the plain `release` profile.
# Fast dev loop: workspace code at opt-level=0 (fastest to compile) and keep
# incremental on for the inner loop. Dependencies default to opt-level=0 too;
# set deps to a higher opt-level only if dev-runtime perf needs it (not needed
# for the CLI/compiler, which is I/O-bound).
# Line tables only (file:line backtraces): full debuginfo filled target/debug past 200 GB.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 0
incremental = true
debug = "line-tables-only"

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 0
debug = false

# Release: keep line tables for panic backtraces, avoid full debuginfo bloat.
[profile.release]
debug = "line-tables-only"

# Local `make install-dev`: release optimizations, but incremental with many
# codegen units so an edit rebuilds in seconds. CI and published builds use `release`.
[profile.dev-install]
inherits = "release"
incremental = true
codegen-units = 256

# Published binaries (orb, the shell programs, orb-desktop): whole-program LTO in
# one codegen unit for size and speed. Line tables stay in the build so the
# release job can split them into a symbol file per platform before stripping.
[profile.dist]
inherits = "release"
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
debug = "line-tables-only"

[profile.wasm-release]
inherits = "release"
# opt-level 3 (not "z"): the size win comes from gzipping the baked corpus in
# orbital-compiler/build.rs — size-optimized codegen made vello's hot loops
# ~10x slower for a ~1MB saving.
opt-level = 3
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
strip = "debuginfo"

[patch.crates-io]
dioxus-native = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-rust/renderers/dioxus/vendor/dioxus-native" }
blitz-dom = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-rust/renderers/dioxus/vendor/blitz-dom" }

# The public crates depend on each other by git; inside this workspace they are
# the submodule checkouts under crates/.
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-core"]
orbital-core = { path = "crates/orbital-core" }
orbital-core-base = { path = "crates/orbital-core/crates/base" }
orbital-core-eval = { path = "crates/orbital-core/crates/eval" }
orbital-core-runtime = { path = "crates/orbital-core/crates/runtime" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-canvas"]
orbital-canvas = { path = "crates/orbital-canvas" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-ffi"]
orbital-ffi = { path = "crates/orbital-ffi" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-typescript"]
orbital-shell-typescript = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-typescript" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-python"]
orbital-shell-python = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-python" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-rust"]
orbital-shell-rust = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-rust" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-ios"]
orbital-shell-ios = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-ios" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-android"]
orbital-shell-android = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-android" }
[patch."https://github.com/almadar-io/orbital-shell-chrome"]
orbital-shell-chrome = { path = "crates/orbital-shell-chrome" }

[package]
name = "kflow-demo"
version = "1.2.3"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["A <a@x.io>", "B"]

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
local = { path = "../local" }

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "macros"]
optional = true

[[bin]]
name = "a"
path = "src/a.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "b"
path = "src/b.rs"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
